namespace Shapes {
  export interface Box {
    width: number;
  }
}
namespace Shapes {
  export interface Box {
    height: number;
  }
  export function area(box: Box): number {
    return box.width * box.height;
  }
}
const box: Shapes.Box = { width: 3, height: 4 };
console.log(Shapes.area(box));
